keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: The phrase you would type into the LinkedIn job search, for example python developer. Required: an empty search is refused before anything is opened or charged.

location.title: Location
location.description: A place name, for example United States or Berlin. Empty searches LinkedIn globally.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Jobs are sold per delivered row, so this is the ceiling that protects your budget. Jobs past it come back free with status NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT.

datePosted.title: Posted within
datePosted.description: The filter is sent to LinkedIn and, when the page carries a date, applied again in code so a silent ignore cannot slip through.

includeDescription.title: Open each job page for the full description
includeDescription.description: Opening each job page costs time but is the difference between a list of titles and a product. Turn it off for a fast list of cards without descriptions.
includeDescription.groupDescription: Opening each job page costs time but is the difference between a list of titles and a product.

maxSearches.title: Search lenses
maxSearches.description: A guest search carries 60 job cards and page offsets do not work, so depth comes from date windows: unfiltered, past week, past 24 hours. Each carries its own 60 cards and they overlap only partly (measured: 14 shared ids). 3 is the maximum.
